items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Professor Douglas Daniels, who is a young Black History professor up there, invited me to talk to the class.

ctx.x: Yeah. I either want to do it at Santa Barbara or maybe San Diego State College.

Oh, incidentally, I was at a Black History in the University of California, Santa Barbara, about a month ago. Professor Douglas Daniels, who is a young Black History professor up there, invited me to talk to the class. It's summer school, and I guess there were between 18 and 20 people in the class, and I think out of 18 to 20 there were 6 or 7 Black students. And I asked if anybody had ever heard of Charlie Parker, and nobody had ever heard of Charlie Parker except for one kid who was in high school -- he…
